children: Oxford Square Capital notified the trustee it will redeem $15,000,000 of its 5.50% Notes due 2028, with redemption on October 14, 2026.
Company elected to redeem $15,000,000 of the $80.5M aggregate Notes outstanding (5.50% due 2028).
Redemption date is October 14, 2026; redemption price $25 per Note plus accrued interest from July 31, 2026.
Trustee will notify holders per the indenture; holders must present Notes to U.S. Bank Corporate Trust Services for payment.
